subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — marketplace purchase & reseller next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acmeanalytics.com>, procurement@cloudresell.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — marketplace purchase & reseller next steps

Tom / CloudResell team,

Attaching the current MAP for Acme Analytics and the AWS listing checklist. This week I want to confirm the procurement path so we can lock the purchase order and get the AWS listing live before the end of month. High-level asks:

- Confirm whether Acme will transact via AWS Marketplace private offers or through CloudResell as the reseller.
- If reseller, confirm invoice flow, tax handling, and estimated procurement lead time.
- If Marketplace listing, confirm expected listing date and any missing seller docs.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_Playbook_v1.2.pdf, AWS_Listing_Checklist.xlsx

Proposed next milestone: finalize procurement path by 2026-03-18, sign paperwork by 2026-03-22, go-live/purchase by 2026-03-24.

Owners I have in flight:
- Marissa (owner, Redwood) — MAP consolidation, HubSpot updates, DocuSign routing
- Karthik (SE) — technical listing inputs and SSO requirements
- Sergio (Partner Ops) — reseller onboarding coordination

Can CloudResell confirm their preferred timeline and any docs they need from our legal team?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@cloudresell.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — marketplace purchase & reseller next steps

Marissa, thanks for the MAP and checklist. A couple quick clarifications from Acme side:

1) We prefer to consolidate spend through our AWS account using Marketplace private offers, but procurement is open to a reseller if it speeds up implementation.
2) If we go reseller, we need to see an example invoice and confirmation that CloudResell handles VAT and US state tax on behalf of seller.
3) Timeline: Procurement lead says 7-10 business days to approve a private offer once the PO and SOW are attached. That lines up with your proposed dates but leaves little buffer.

On the technical side, Karthik, can you confirm SSO/SCIM scoping — we have a pilot with 12 users and will need a staging instance for testing before purchase.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Data Platforms | Acme Analytics
tom.h@acmeanalytics.com

From: CloudResell Procurement <procurement@cloudresell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — marketplace purchase & reseller next steps

Hi Marissa / Tom,

We can act as the reseller for this purchase. Quick notes and timeline from our procurement team:

- Reseller onboarding form attached. We need completed W9 (or VAT registration for EU) and proof of authorization from Redwood to resell.
- Invoice flow: CloudResell will issue a consolidated invoice to Acme and remit payment to Redwood per agreed net terms. We handle US sales tax collection where applicable.
- Estimated timeline: 
  - Day 0: onboarding form submitted (we can expedite to same day if docs are ready)
  - Day 3-5: reseller account setup + PO acceptance
  - Day 5-8: delivery scheduling and invoice issuance

Attachment: reseller_onboarding_form.pdf

If Acme can share the PO template this week, we can map fields and return a sample invoice for legal review.

Best,
Lina Morales
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudResell Inc
procurement@cloudresell.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Weekly MAP checkpoint — reseller agreement redline question

Marissa, team,

I looked over the sample reseller flow and have one flag for discussion before we sign off: the indemnity and data handling clause in the standard reseller addendum is written to pass customer data obligations to the reseller. For Marketplace private offer scenarios we need to ensure Redwood remains the data controller for all production instances and that reseller is only a billing intermediary.

I attached a redline with a suggested clause to preserve our control and to limit reseller liability to billing and distribution actions. Please review and let me know if you want me to push the redline directly to CloudResell or route via Marissa.

Attachment: reseller_agreement_redline.docx

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acmeanalytics.com>, procurement@cloudresell.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated MAP update & action owners — next milestones and close timeline

Team,

Thanks for the quick responses. Consolidated status and next steps below — please reply with any changes by EOD Wednesday 2026-03-18.

MAP status snapshot:
- Procurement path: CloudResell confirmed reseller route; Acme has preference for Marketplace private offer but is OK with reseller if contract/tax path is cleaner. Status: PENDING final PO decision from Acme.
- Legal: Redwood redline completed and shared with CloudResell. Status: REVIEW (Neha to confirm final redline approach).
- Technical: Karthik to provision staging for 12 pilot users and share SSO checklist. Status: IN PROGRESS.

Action items (owners / due dates):
1) Acme to decide procurement route (Marketplace vs Reseller) — Owner: Tom Hargreaves — Due: 2026-03-18
2) CloudResell to return sample invoice and confirm tax treatment — Owner: Lina Morales (CloudResell) — Due: 2026-03-17
3) Redwood legal to finalize reseller redline and propose wording to CloudResell — Owner: Neha Kapoor — Due: 2026-03-16
4) Karthik to deliver staging instance and SSO/SCIM checklist — Owner: Karthik Iyer — Due: 2026-03-19
5) Marissa to prepare DocuSign bundle (SOW + reseller addendum or PO) depending on procurement path — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2026-03-20

Target close timeline (agreed tentative):
- Procurement path decision: 2026-03-18
- Paperwork signed: 2026-03-22
- Purchase and access granted: 2026-03-24

Links: HubSpot deal DL-2026-0031 and DocuSign envelope to be populated once reseller wording finalized. I will update MAP_Acme_Playbook_v1.2 with the final procurement route and circulate a DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Consolidated MAP update & action owners — next milestones and close timeline

Marissa / all,

Thanks for the clear breakdown — this is helpful. Acme will confirm procurement route by close of day 2026-03-18. We will aim for reseller only if CloudResell can provide the sample invoice and confirm tax handling by 2026-03-17 as requested.

For now, we are on track. I will share our PO template in a follow-up email to Lina.

Best,
Tom
